title: source-gates never runs scripts/test-repository-check-scope.mjs, which bun run test runs first
description: Found closing QCLI-375 (2026-09-25). package.json test runs test:repository-check-scope, then test:package-artifact-delivery, then bun test. After QCLI-375, source-gates (prepublish.mjs runSourceGates) runs the second (package_artifact_delivery gate) and every test/ file, but NOT scripts/test-repository-check-scope.mjs, so a PR that breaks it goes green in CI. OBJECT MEASURED: runSourceGates at fix/QCLI-375 head 07f8358, and package.json scripts. NOT MEASURED: any other scripts/test-*.mjs outside bun run test. Likely a one-line named gate, proved the QCLI-375 way (a deliberate break goes red naming the gate, and its revert goes green).

acceptanceCriteria.text: source-gates runs scripts/test-repository-check-scope.mjs as its own named gate
A deliberate break in that script turns source-gates red naming the gate, and its revert turns it green (two CI measurements)

plan: 1. Add a repository_check_scope gate to runSourceGates running bun run test:repository-check-scope, beside package_artifact_delivery, so the qualification record names it.
2. Run prepublish.mjs locally: clean passes; a deliberately broken script fails only that gate.
3. CI: a break commit turns source-gates red naming repository_check_scope on both triggers, and its revert turns it green. Cite runs only once they have concluded.
implementationNotes: PROOF on PR opum-ai/quest-cli#283. LOCAL: clean prepublish 18/18 passed; the same script broken (a bad bun run target) made only repository_check_scope fail, exit 1, 17 passed. CI, clean c6a0bd4: push 36171999377 and pull_request 36172004452 both success. BREAK 78a9855: pull_request run 36172700390 failure, exactly one gate failed, repository_check_scope ("bun run format:check-deliberately-broken failed with exit code 1"), 16 passed. That head produced NO push run. FINDING: the push trigger paths omitted test-repository-check-scope.mjs, check-lockfile-pins.mjs, check-layers.mjs, biome.json and bunfig.toml, all read by source-gates. Fixed in the same PR (workflow paths). My watcher waited for a 4th run that could not exist; the orchestrator flagged the stall, and it was stopped. REVERT + paths fix, 9871531, tree identical to c6a0bd4 outside the workflow file: push 36176000629 and pull_request 36176003668 both success, 18/18 gates each; the push run firing confirms the paths list is read.
finalSummary: CHANGE: scripts/test-repository-check-scope.mjs, which bun run test runs first, is now the named repository_check_scope gate in prepublish.mjs runSourceGates, the required source-gates context. It had run in no CI context. ALSO FIXED, found by the proof: the push trigger of prepublication-qualification.yml did not watch test-repository-check-scope.mjs, check-lockfile-pins.mjs, check-layers.mjs, biome.json or bunfig.toml, so a push touching only those produced no push-triggered source-gates run. They are now listed. VERIFIED: local break made only the new gate fail. CI break 78a9855, run 36172700390: only repository_check_scope failed, 16 passed. Revert 9871531, runs 36176000629 (push) and 36176003668 (pull_request): 18/18 passed on each. LIMIT: the paths fix was measured by the push run firing on a head that touched the workflow file itself, not on a head touching only one of the newly-listed files.
